summary: Iter5 tested Stripe Subscriptions, Referral Program, and Live Match Map end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass. Playwright verified /live (public, Leaflet map + 12 pins + correct h1), /r/TESTCODE (writes cp_ref_code to localStorage + redirects /), /pro hero + Start $1 trial button (click actually redirects to real Stripe Checkout URL cs_test_...), Navbar shows Live + Pro links for logged-in handyman, handyman dashboard shows pro-upsell-banner + referral-panel (with CP-prefixed share URL) + copy-link button, customer dashboard also shows referral-panel. Fixed one demo-login data-hygiene bug so role resets on each demo login (was causing customer session to return handyman role).

minor.issue: Did not reset demo user's role on each login; if a prior test mutated demo.customer to role=handyman via /auth/set-role the state leaked. Fixed in this iteration — demo-login now self-heals role to match request body.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2222 lines — still not split. Highly recommended to modularize (auth, jobs, subscriptions, referrals, map, stripe/webhooks).

Subscription checkout attaches a $1 InvoiceItem AFTER creating the Checkout Session; Stripe attaches all pending invoice items to the first invoice, but ordering means if session creation succeeds and InvoiceItem fails you get a session without the trial fee — consider creating InvoiceItem before the Session (rollback on failure).
_get_subscription lookup by user_id relies on webhook writes to db.subscriptions; ensure webhook idempotency and dedup by stripe subscription id (already handled but worth documenting).
/api/map/stream has no auth or rate limiting on the public SSE — a single client can hold 100 slots; consider IP-based cap.

REFERRAL_REWARD_CENTS credit is granted but no code path was found that spends/decrements credits when a job is booked — verify credit application in checkout/booking flow (not part of this iter's scope but flagged).
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo-login {role:'customer'|'handyman'} — now always resets role after fix.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed job during accept-gating test; a couple of ephemeral referral users via demo-login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 file /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_new_features.py plus prior test_new_features.py + test_regression_iter4.py remain reusable. All new endpoints (/subscriptions/*, /referrals/*, /map/*) confirmed working. Real Stripe checkout URL is returned (not stubbed). If future testing needs to force 402 on accept, ensure demo handyman has NO row in db.subscriptions with status trialing/active.
rca of the issue: test_checkout_as_customer_403 initially failed because demo.customer had role='handyman' persisted in DB from earlier test runs (a prior test/agent called POST /api/auth/set-role). Root cause: /api/auth/demo-login only fetched the seeded user without normalizing role. Fix applied: demo-login now updates the user record so role matches the requested demo role.
